prompt: Explain this PowerShell error in one or two sentences and say how to fix it.
input: File C:\scripts\run.ps1 cannot be loaded because running scripts is disabled on this system.

pass: The PowerShell execution policy blocks scripts. Change it, for example with Set-ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned for your user.
Scripts are disabled by the execution policy; use Set-ExecutionPolicy to allow them.
fail: The file run.ps1 contains a syntax error.
You must run PowerShell on Linux.
